{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-s0cc","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-yotd: TH_2 includes C_R but RFC 9528 excludes it","description":"## Spec deviation: TH_2 composition

**File:** python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py  
**Lines:** 323 (initiator), 568 (responder)

**What the code does:**
```python
th_2_input = cbor2.dumps(self._g_y) + cbor2.dumps(self._c_r) + cbor2.dumps(h_msg1)
```
Includes 3 elements: G_Y, C_R, H(message_1)

**What RFC 9528 §5.3.2 requires:**
> Compute the transcript hash TH_2 = H(G_Y, H(message_1)), where
> H() is the EDHOC hash algorithm... The input to the hash function
> is a CBOR Sequence.

Only 2 elements: G_Y and H(message_1). **C_R is NOT included in TH_2.**

This would produce a different transcript hash value than other implementations following the RFC, breaking interop and failing against RFC 9529 test vectors.

**Severity:** P1 - correctness/security/spec-compliance.
